question: A solid cuboid with dimensions 24 cm × 16 cm × 10 cm is melted to form smaller solid cubes with sides of length 4 cm. Determine the number of cubes formed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of cubes = Total Volume ÷ Volume of 1 small cube

Number of cubes = (24 × 16 × 10) ÷ (4 × 4 × 4)

Number of cubes = 3840 ÷ 64 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cubes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of cuboid (L) = 24 cm, Breadth (B) = 16 cm, Height (H) = 10 cm

Side of small cube (a) = 4 cm

**Formula Used:**

Number of cubes = Volume of cuboid ÷ Volume of one cube
